title: Witnessed Occurrence Against the Münchhausen Trilemma: SFT’s Constructive Counterexample Argument
description:
One valid counterexample disproves the universal epistemic trilemma as a whole. The complete argument is placed upfront, immediately after the abstract.

SFT establishes that justification can escape all three branches of the Agrippan and Münchhausen trilemma. Witnessed occurrence supplies the ground; complete constructive derivations preserve it. The paper explains why the same justification has no infinite regress, circular evidential dependency or unsupported stopping point, and why requiring certification without regard to the exhibited ground would assume the disputed regress requirement.

Witnessed occurrence and constructive proof: Smithian Fold Theory’s direct counterexample argument against the Münchhausen and Agrippan justification trilemma.

Maria Smith’s edition 6 establishes a terminating constructive justification through SFT’s existing zero-axiom, zero-free-parameter derivations. The paper presents the full argument from exhibited occurrence through structural One, complete count traces, canonical identity, exhaustive primitive exclusions and proof-preserving inference. A worked fine-structure derivation includes the intermediate mathematics and exact terminal ratio.

The philosophical argument addresses Sextus Empiricus and Hans Albert directly, including the justification of criteria, recognition errors, circularity and regress. It distinguishes the positions of Aristotle, Descartes, foundationalism and Gödel. The opening section supplies the full positive argument for ultimate warrant, placed immediately after the abstract and explicitly excludes infinite regress, circular support and an unsupported endpoint and require evidence for both affirmative claims and adverse criticism. The accompanying editorial verification gives the exact target, evidence, reasoning and disposition of each objection.

Read the full paper in the PDF preview. The source supplement includes the manuscript, all references, pinned V3 source citations, V4 Lean declaration references, retained verification provenance and the review record. The philosophical conclusion is argued in the paper; the formal proofs establish the mathematical statements it uses.
